title: FOR AS TRULY AS I LIVE

lines.text: For as truly as I live,
All the earth shall be filled
With the glory of the Lord.
For as truly as I live,
All the earth shall be filled
With the glory of the Lord.
For He is the Lord of all the earth.
The Lord of all the earth.
For He is the Lord of all the earth.

lyrics:
[Verse]
For as truly as I live,
All the earth shall be filled
With the glory of the Lord.
(repeat)

[Verse]
The glory, the glory,
The glory of the Lord.
For as truly as I live,
All the earth shall be filled
With the glory of the Lord.

[Verse]
Break forth into singing, Zion,
For He is the Lord of all the earth.
(repeat)
The Lord, the Lord,
The Lord of all the earth.
Break forth into singing, Zion,
For He is the Lord of all the earth.
